    "id": "cw.1206c6393381ca",
    "text": "You wake in a frost-covered workshop. A fire, some provisions, and a handful of people gathered around you are all you have."

  {

    "text": "Terraced fields carved into the hillsides feed many households. But local scrap is scarce, so everyday tools must be brought in from elsewhere."

  {

  {
